text:
Alex: quick heads-up — scheduled deploy tonight 23:00 UTC for v3.7. Small schema tweak to logs table; no DB downtime expected. Freeze window 22:30-00:30. Please be reachable for rollback.
Devon: adding watchers: Priya, Jordi, Lina. I'll be primary for the canary and telemetry checks.
Sam: noted — i'll take midnight handoff at 00:00 UTC and cover rollbacks/alerts.
Maria: quick Q — what's the main risk vector here? consumer-facing change or infra warmup?
Alex: mainly infra warmup. embeddings service will repopulate KV cache, so expect transient p50/p95 spikes. no customer-visible schema changes to payloads.
Devon: deployment plan: canary -> 10% at 23:00, monitor 10m; if metrics stable, ramp 50% after 15m, then full. Rollback conditions: p50 > 120ms OR error rate > 0.5% OR internal 5xx spike.
Sam: smoke checks to run after canary:

```
# basic embedding smoke
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
# confirm canary pods
kubectl get pods -n embeddings -l release=canary
```
Maria: link to dashboards pls?
Devon: grafana: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/embeddings/embedding-health — look at p50/p95, 5xx rate, queue depth. I've added alerts for thresholds.
Alex: I've made a short runbook: https://confluence.redwood.dev/display/ONCALL/nightwatch-deploy — rollback steps 2-5 are the important ones (scale canary down, reroute traffic, rollback image tag).
deploy-bot: Canary started for deployment v3.7 (canary=5 pods) — job id 98721
Sam: i'll tail logs: `stern embeddings -n prod -l release=canary` — will escalate if errors > 5% sustained
Priya: i'll watch autoscaler and node join times, can adjust node pools if pod scheduling lags.
Jordi: i'll monitor edge/ingress 5xx and LB healthchecks.
Lina: devex on standby for quick rollback scripts or routing changes.
Maria: if anyone needs to trigger immediate rollback, ping `@Devon @Alex @Sam` and use channel `#eng-oncall` — no DMs for rollbacks please.
Devon: tagging watchers now in the channel and enabling 1min alerting for the canary window.
Alex: final notes for handoff: keep an eye on embeddings p95 and queue length. Expected deploy duration ~15-20m. Contact chain: Devon -> Alex -> Sam.
Sam: acknowledged. i'll be on call from 00:00, pager on.
Oncall-Bot: handoff recorded: Alex -> Sam at 00:00 UTC. Good luck :rocket:
